conflicts.summary: Three different complete lists are published today for the same GTIN 4104260076501 / 250 ml. List C (manufacturer, page modified 2026-08-27): phenoxyethanol system plus new 'Terpineol' and 'Pinene', 'Coco-Glucoside' (hyphenated), reordered. List B (dm.de now AND manufacturer+dm on 2026-08-10): same system without Terpineol/Pinene. List A (Rossmann and Müller): older-looking isothiazolinone-preserved formula (Methylchloroisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, Formic Acid, Magnesium Chloride/Nitrate, Laureth-4, no Phenoxyethanol, no Tocopherol, no Glycerin); Rossmann and Müller lists also differ from each other (Rossmann has Citric Acid, Müller has Benzoic Acid and different order). Not an ordering-only difference.
